player_prompt.intro:
U munghana {player_id} ematshan'weni {num_rounds} ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Ematshan'wini, tlhela nambari kwalomu {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Loko zonke zi tlheleriwile, xivundzukulu ikuwa (2/3)x(xikolo xa zonke),
na munghana loyi nambari yake yi karhi kona eka xivundzukulu u nyawula matshamu yoloye.
Arabela na nambari yaku eka mfomelo '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomete leyi nga tirhiki; hi kombela u rhumela ku vhumbha ka wena tanihi [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ku vhumba ku fanele ku va exikarhi ka {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
message.round_draw: Loko u wu rhendzerile wa ha ringana.

outcome.p0_wins: Mutlangi wa 0 u wine mimphikizano yo tala.
outcome.p1_wins: Mutlangi wo sungula u wine mimphikizano yo tala.
outcome.draw: Ntlangu hinkwawo wu ve na ku ringana.
